title: Public landing page
narrative: Anyone who lands on the portal domain sees the tender-hub marketing page: brand identity, the four service lanes, and the top-right Sign in / Register CTAs.

test_steps.step: Open the portal root URL in an incognito window
test_steps.expected: Hero + Notices/Register/Sign-in in top nav render without a horizontal scroll on 375px viewports

test_steps.step: Tap the language switcher (EN → RU → KK)
test_steps.expected: Copy translates immediately; no console errors

title: Public tender board
narrative: Public list of every published tender/RFP/RFQ across all tenants of the portal.

test_steps.step: Verify at least one PUBLISHED notice appears with title + closing date + budget
test_steps.expected: Cards render; DRAFT notices are hidden

test_steps.step: Click a card to open the Notice Detail
test_steps.expected: Detail page shows description, deadline, downloads and QA thread

title: Vendor registration — start
narrative: Section A (Identity) is the entry point. As soon as the vendor picks a file for any slot, a silent draft is created so nothing is lost.

test_steps.step: Fill Section A (Company name, contact, email, phone, country)
test_steps.expected: Continue button unlocks once required fields are valid

test_steps.step: Attach a KYC doc to the ID slot
test_steps.expected: File uploads with progress; a resume-link toast appears

title: Vendor registration — check status
narrative: Any vendor with the emailed resume-token can paste it here to see current status without logging in.

test_steps.step: Paste an invalid token
test_steps.expected: Toast: 'Token invalid or expired — request a new resume link…' (Bug 7 fix)

test_steps.step: Paste a valid token
test_steps.expected: Status card shows stage + reviewer notes + submission timestamp

title: Admin login page
narrative: Dedicated admin login. HTTPOnly-cookie based, CSRF double-submit.

test_steps.step: Try login with wrong password
test_steps.expected: Toast surfaces backend error; no console stack trace

test_steps.step: Try login with correct credentials
test_steps.expected: Redirect to /admin dashboard within 1s
